*''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 6|Old Fear, and New Fear]]'' - the sixth chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
*''[[Knife of Dreams/Epilogue|Remember the Old Saying]]'' - the epilogue of ''[[Knife of Dreams]]''.
*''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 30|Old Advice]]'' - the thirtieth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.
